title: Customer Master
description: One record per person or company who's bought a truck, bought parts, or had service done with us.
x-sap-analogue: KNA1 (general customer master), with per-store scoping like KNVV
x-api-note: Get Customer v3 (read, bulk/delta) and the older Customers API v1 (search/create/update) are both documented and reachable.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.

customerid.description: The unique DMS ID for this customer — the key everything else joins to
customerid.x-source-title: CDK Drive Get Customer v3 PDF

hostitemid.description: Also documented as 'the DMS customer ID', functionally the same key concept as customerId
hostitemid.x-source-title: CDK Drive Get Customer v3 PDF
